facts.value: Clears cmd_vars[0]. If u.kb.x64 is false, assigns specials_aerial_vertical_momentum to self_vel.y and sets x64 true; otherwise it skips that local velocity assignment. Requests ftKb_MS_SpecialAirS with arguments 0, 0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f, NULL, calls ftAnim_8006EBA4 and installs fn_800F53AC as accessory4_cb. The assignment is not additive and performs no sign or finite-value check. Re-entry while x64 remains true skips reapplication; a universal once-per-airtime invariant is unproved.
facts.rationale: Replaces unsupported upward-launch wording with exact guarded source behavior.

evidence.why: Complete entry shows the guard, assignment and publication order.

facts.value: Calls ft_80081D0C and performs move-local cleanup only for a nonzero result: calls it_802ADC34 for a non-NULL u.kb.hat.x0 and clears it, unconditionally clears u.kb.x64, then requests ftCo_LandingFallSpecial_Enter(gobj, false, specials_landing_lag). The landing callee can instead select HammerLanding; otherwise it supplies (0.1F + fp->x2EC) / landing_lag as animation rate. Neither this caller nor that division validates zero, negative, infinite or NaN lag. Exact contact semantics are not inferred from GroundOrAir names.
facts.rationale: Preserves the proved guard and writes while incorporating optional landing and float boundaries.

facts.value: Implements Kirby ground/air SpecialS Hammer entry and action callbacks, a shared command-driven article lifecycle with callback-conflict diagnostics, and SpecialN helpers exporting fighter position, scaled star-state collision bounds, recovery velocity parameters and an HSD_Joint accessory descriptor. Source diagnostic arrays are present; compiled section contents, full object layouts and upstream capture/copy gameplay causation remain unresolved.
facts.rationale: Records complete owned TU scope without adopting rendered names or unproved section/layout claims.

evidence.why: Active consumers establish descriptor, geometry and velocity roles.
